title: Typed search lists rows nobody can tell apart ("Oreo / OREO" and "Oreo", two barcodes, no size)
comment: DEFECTS row D-245. Reverts the cc06209 hunk in dedupeListings(): the `shown` key (words a shopper reads) no longer merges rows.
ifMissed: A list-quality rule on typed search results: no two rows in one result list may read the same to a shopper (same words and size), run over the answer key's typed forms.
